text.p: Here are highlights of stories reported by Hungary's press, based on information by Nepszabadsag's Hungary Around the Clock service. For further details on how to subscribe to Hungary Around the Clock, please contact Monica Kovacs at (361) 351 2440 or fax your request to (361) 351 7141.
ALL PAPERS
- US Defence Secretary William Perry was the guest of honour at a gala party in Washington Tuesday night to commemorate the 1,100th anniversary of the Magyars' arrival in the Carpathian Basin. @

- Speaker of Parliament Zoltan Gal presented a letter from President Arpad Goncz to the Russian Duma Speaker in Moscow yesterday, seeking help regarding the return of the library of Sarospatak Calvinist Church, presently held in Nizhny Novgorod.
- All Hungarian parliamentary parties concurred during a day of political debate on social insurance Wednesday that its solution is inseparable from economic growth.
- The opposition Christian Democrats and the Democratic Forum seek to renominate Janos Bruhacs for the vacant post of constitutional judge despite his being voted down by Parliament on Tuesday. @
- Working groups of the coalition parties' parliamentary factions somewhat narrowed their differences regarding the bill on conflicts on interest yesterday.
- Prime Minister Gyula Horn will visit Poland on November 19-20.

- A senior official of MOL criticised the CEO of Panrusgas yesterday for saying the latter company will sell natural gas to large-scale consumers from the pipeline to be built through Hungary in the near future. @
- A hand-grenade exploded early Wednesday outside Leroy's Country Pub in Budapest causing no injuries but damaging nearly a dozen cars.
MAGYAR HIRLAP

- The cabinet today is to debate a report on amending the act on social administration and social care and will also deal with the general reserves of the 1996 budget, agriculture subsidy system and the concept of a bill on refugee rights.
- Industrial output grew by 4.9 percent in September. @
- The seven insurance companies offering compulsory car liability insurance have proposed a 28.6 percent premium increase as of January to the Insurance Supervision Authority.
- Treasury bill yields continued to fall on Tuesday and Wednesday.
- The directors of the small pharmaceutical company Horizon-Multiplan have lowered their estimated annual revenue figure from 356 million forints to 130-145 million forints.
- The brewery Soproni Sorgyar yesterday announced 695 million forint pre-tax profit on revenues of 11.4 billion forints in the first three quarters of the year. @
- Shares of the Budapest Electricity Works can be swapped for compensation coupons from November 25.
MAGYAR NEMZET
- Foreign Minister Laszlo Kovacs conferred with officials at the Pentagon, the State Department and the National Security Council on Wednesday on the planned NATO enlargement.
- A Hungarian-Russian intergovernmental joint committee on maintaining military graves agreed in Budapest Wednesday that the unearthing of Hungarian military graves in Russia can start next year. @
NAPI GAZDASAG
- The mobile phone company Pannon GSM yesterday began operating its fourth exchange centre in Szolnok.
- The agricultural company Agrimpex between January and September generated an after-tax profit of 512 million forints.
NEPSZABADSAG
- Customs guards found components of two dismantled tanks in two Slovak trucks at the Hungarian-Slovenian border.
-- Budapest newsroom (36-1) 327 4040
